headline: Why won't he commit after all these years together?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The pictures were hidden, but your hand found the one with every means to build.
Every tool is laid out and ready on his table.
You asked why he will not commit after all these years. The complete working table catches my attention.
The years together are real, and the commitment is still absent.
Something appears where years together would become a named commitment. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You reached without seeing him and chose the card held at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of him has room.
You asked what has held the commitment across the years. This card brings me to the one rope.
Still, the future remains held after the time you named.
Something stands between the relationship and its future. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the future…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the picture, yet your hand went to the one travelling light.
The bundle stays on his stick as he moves.
You asked why the years together have not settled the future. The carried bundle is the part I notice first.
But the relationship has moved through years, while commitment remains unsettled.
The thing that has hold of the commitment keeps it carried without being settled. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the commitment…
